name: congress-feed
description: Cloudflare Workers service ingesting US congressional STOCK Act stock-trade disclosures (House + Senate) and pushing structured trade events to clients.

scripts.migrate: echo 'Run D1 migrations via Turso CLI instead'
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: _SENTRY_RELEASE=$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && sentry-cli releases new $_SENTRY_RELEASE --org=jays-services --project=congress-trade && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org=jays-services --project=congress-trade --release=$_SENTRY_RELEASE --strip-prefix 'dist/..' dist
scripts.postdeploy: if [ -n "$SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN" ]; then npm run sentry:sourcemaps || echo '::warning::sentry sourcemaps upload failed (non-fatal); the Worker deploy already succeeded'; else echo '::warning::SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN not set; skipping sentry sourcemaps upload'; fi
